title: Leading Epstein Reporter Details Her Decades-Long Investigation: ‘This Is a Crime’
author: John Harwood
content:
Even **Julie K. Brown** , the investigative reporter who broke the Jeffrey
Epstein story wide open [back in
2018](https://www.miamiherald.com/topics/jeffrey-epstein/), thinks she hasn't
learned the full scope of this crime scandal involving rich and powerful men
and the young girls who were victimized.

In this Substack Live, **Zeteo contributor John Harwood** and Brown - who
recently
[joined](https://jkbjournalist.substack.com/?utm_campaign=profile_chips)
Substack - talked about Trump and Epstein, what's in the files that have been
released (and the [99% that haven't](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2026/jan/06/epstein-files-release-justice-department)), and whether the
Trump administration can continue to ignore calls for the full release.

The conversation between Brown and Harwood was live on
[Zeteo.com](http://zeteo.com) and the Substack app, and both took questions
from subscribers in the live audience. Share your thoughts on the discussion
in the comments below, and be sure to keep an eye out for the next Substack
Live.
